title: Pokemon Music disc
description: Adds Pokémon music onto Minecraft discs
body:
## Pokémon Music Discs

Bring the iconic sounds of the Pokémon world into your Minecraft universe! This pack adds a massive collection of custom music discs featuring legendary battle themes and tracks from various Pokémon generations. Each disc comes with its own unique texture, custom item name, and fully functioning audio track.

* **Survival Friendly:** Every single disc can be crafted in survival mode.
* **Iconic Soundtracks:** Includes themes from Sinnoh, Alola, Galar, Paldea, and more!

This is just the beginning expect even more iconic Pokémon themes to be added over time!

---

### Installation & Setup 

To make sure everything works perfectly, this pack requires two components:

1. **The Datapack:** For the crafting recipes to work, you **must** install this pack inside your world's datapack folder (`saves/<your_world>/datapacks`) and run the `/reload` command in-game.
2. **The Resource Pack:** Place the resource pack folder into your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` directory to enable the custom textures and music.

---
